features: CHARGING CAPACITY- This power bank is built with a 10000mAh battery that provides solid backup power for daily use, travel, and emergency top-ups.
WIRELESS + MAGSECURE- Comes with 15W wireless charging and MagSecure compatibility, including a magnetic ring for stable alignment during cable-free charging.
RAPID CHARGING- Supports Type-C PD with input/output and 22.5W high-speed charging function for quick power delivery across modern devices.
DUAL O/P- Comes with high-speed Type-C output port - 5V/3A, 9V/2.22A, 12V/1.67A, 3.3V–11V/2A PPS, and USB-A output port- 5V/3A, 9V/2A, 10V/2.25A, 12V/1.85A for flexible device charging
PPS SUPPORT- Automatically regulates the charging profile for compatible phones to maintain stable performance.
SAFETY PROTECTION- Integrated safeguards protect against overcharge, overload, and short circuits, ensuring safe and reliable charging every time.
LED INDICATOR- A clear LED indicator displays real-time battery status for easy monitoring of remaining power and charging progress.
CARRY CABLE- Includes an attached flat cable that doubles as a carry handle, making the power bank easy to pack, hold, and use on the go
